correctness.rationale: Every base has either r handle or r-1 handle plus one of t tail elements. The Bernoulli K tail count has p=tr/(d+tr), d=s-r+1. Total covariance is orthogonal sum of uniform-subset handle projector, tail one-hot projector, and rank-one p(1-p)vv^T on v=(-1_s/s,1_t/t). This gives stated positive lambda_handle,lambda_tail,lambda_bridge and a 1-dimensional kernel. Explicit positive ratios prove bridge strictly smaller than both, and difference of handle/tail equals ((r-1)(d(t-2)-(r-2)))/(s(s-1)), giving crossover. Direct substitution yields three proportional scalings. Independently enumerated all bases and exact rational covariance for parameter tuples (3,2,2),(4,2,2),(5,4,3),(6,2,4),(6,6,2), verifying eigenvectors and eigenvalues.
